title: COUNTROWS ( ALL ( Product ) ) counts the blank row

source.quote: ALL considers the blank row as valid.
source.supports: the article's COUNTROWS ( ALL ( Product ) ) is one more than the rows of the table, because of the blank row

source.quote: The results show a difference of 1 row in the table rows count.
source.supports: COUNTROWS(ALL(table)) is one more than COUNTROWS(ALLNOBLANKROW(table)) when the table has the blank row

derivation: Product has 3 rows (Bike, Lock, Bell) plus the blank row for the orphan Sales rows: 4.
